definitions.calibration_score: recorded job score = mean over cases of the case error; case error = mean over windows (panel) or the single recorded case error (game)
definitions.unchanged_app_score: the same formula applied to the before side of the same rows
definitions.agent_activity_window: audited calls strictly between the finished_at of the first full evaluation and the next call of the stated kind
definitions.version_label: taken from the session id prefix (g/j/p = game/jump/panel runs before V2 are V1; v2..v6 = the epoch of the run; v5p02c is the V5b panel run) and the results logs
definitions.dates: UTC, from the audit timestamps (the results logs use local time, UTC+3)
definitions.null_semantics: null = not recorded, not applicable, or no error. Fields that are missing carry a reason under null_reasons of their session. Error fields (error_code, error_message, session_final.error) are null when the operation succeeded, source_changed_since_previous_candidate is null for a first candidate, and the note field of a cross-check is null when there is nothing to add; these carry no separate reason.
